defects.claim_says: 'No held later instrument revokes, supersedes or amends this order.'
defects.source_says: the same claim records four amending orders as later events (EO 13757, EO 13984, EO 14144, EO 14306), and its rationale and the OFR note ('Amended by: EO 13757 ... EO 14144 ... EO 14306') say the order is amended

evidence_checked: all quoted spans and hashes re-checked
event dates compared with printed dates
field-by-field comparison with the planted version
reasoning: This genuine version corrects every later-event date. The 11 notices now carry their printed dates (2016-03-29 to 2026-03-24, each continuing beyond April 1). EO 13757 is dated 2016-12-29, its stated effective date of 12:01 a.m. EST on December 29, 2016. EO 13984 is 2021-01-19, EO 14144 is 2025-01-16 and EO 14306 is 2025-06-06. Hashes, quotes, the 22-clause inventory and the continuation through 2026-10-14 are confirmed, and the status yes is supported. Under the same standard applied in the blind review, the claim still fails on internal consistency. Its rationale and every clause reason say that 0 continuation notices are held, with an empty list, while 11 are attached. Every clause reason also says that no held later instrument amends the order, which contradicts the four amendments the claim itself records. These two contradictions were defects in the planted version as well and are not part of the date shift.
